title: Building Trust Before You Need It
meta: B2 · 约 260 词 · 场景：跨团队关系

sections.heading: 1. Trust Works Like a Bank Account
paragraphs: The worst time to meet the database team is during an outage at midnight.
You need them urgently, they have never heard your name, and every question sounds like a ==demand==.
Even good engineers become careful and slow with strangers.
Think of trust as a bank account.
Every kept promise, shared insight, or small favor is a ==deposit==.
Every urgent request is a ==withdrawal==.
**If you only show up when you need something, your account is always empty.**
The good news is that deposits are cheap.
They take minutes, not weeks, and they ==compound== over time.
You just have to make them when nothing is on fire.
sections.heading_zh: 1. 信任就像一个银行账户
paragraphs_zh: 认识数据库团队最糟糕的时机，就是半夜出故障的时候。
你急着要找他们，他们从没听过你的名字，你问的每个问题听起来都像是在提要求。
再好的工程师，面对陌生人也会变得谨慎、动作变慢。
把信任想象成一个银行账户。
每一次兑现承诺、分享洞察、帮个小忙，都是一笔存款。
每一个紧急请求都是一次取款。
如果你只在有求于人的时候才出现，你的账户永远是空的。
好消息是，存款很便宜。
只需要几分钟，而不是几周，而且会随着时间复利增长。
你只需要在没出事的时候去存。

sections.heading: 2. Small Deposits That Add Up
paragraphs: Start by keeping small promises ==precisely==.
If you say you will send the logs by three, send them by three.
People judge your big commitments by how you handle the tiny ones.
Next, share information before anyone asks.
If your team plans a change that will __double the traffic__ to their service, tell them a month ahead, not the day before.
That kind of early warning is rare, and people __remember who gave it__.
Show up when they are in trouble, too.
When their system has an incident, offer a dashboard, a theory, or simply __an extra pair of eyes__.
**Helping in their crisis is the fastest way to earn help in yours.**
Finally, make the relationship personal in a ==professional== way.
A short coffee chat, a thank-you in their channel, or a question about their roadmap all count.
None of this is ==manipulation==; it is simply what good colleagues do when there is nothing to gain yet.
paragraphs_zh: 先从精确地兑现小承诺开始。
如果你说三点前发日志，那就三点前发。
别人是根据你怎么处理小事，来判断你的大承诺靠不靠谱的。
接着，在别人开口之前就主动同步信息。
如果你们团队计划做一个会让他们服务流量翻倍的改动，提前一个月告诉他们，而不是前一天。
这种提前预警很少见，人们会记住是谁给的。
他们遇到麻烦的时候，你也要出现。
他们的系统出故障时，主动提供一个 dashboard、一个猜测，或者只是多一双眼睛帮着看。
在他们危机时出手相助，是你在自己危机时得到帮助的最快方式。
最后，以职业的方式让关系变得私人一点。
一次简短的咖啡聊天、在他们群里说声谢谢、问问他们的 roadmap，这些都算。
这些都不是在耍手段；这只是好同事在还没有任何好处可图的时候会做的事。

gist.q: 作者用什么比喻来描述信任？
gist.a: 银行账户：守住的承诺、分享的信息、小忙是存款，紧急求助是取款；只在需要时出现，账户永远是空的。

gist.q: 作者建议的「小额存款」有哪些？
gist.a: 精确兑现小承诺；主动提前同步会影响对方的变更；对方出事故时去帮忙；喝咖啡、公开感谢、关心对方路线图。

gist.q: 为什么要在平时而不是出事时建立信任？
gist.a: 出事时对方不认识你，每个问题都像命令；平时存款成本低、会累积，危机时才取得出来。

dictation: If you only show up when you need something, your account is always empty.
People judge your big commitments by how you handle the tiny ones.
Helping in their crisis is the fastest way to earn help in yours.
If you say you will send the logs by three, send them by three.

prompts.q: 你们下个月要做一个营销活动，预计会让风控团队的服务流量翻倍。用 30 秒提前给对方负责人打个招呼。
prompts.ref: Hi Lena, nothing urgent, I just wanted to give you an early heads-up. Next month we're running a campaign that could roughly double the calls to your risk service for about a week. I'll share our traffic forecast once it's ready. Is there anything you'd need from us to prepare, like load test data or a contact on call during the campaign?
prompts.ref_zh: Lena 你好，不着急，只是想提前跟你打个招呼。下个月我们要做一个活动，大概有一周时间，打到你们风控服务的调用量可能会翻一倍左右。流量预估出来后我会发给你。你们需要我们提供什么来做准备吗？比如压测数据，或者活动期间我们这边 on-call 的联系人？

prompts.q: 另一个团队正在处理一个线上事故，和你们没直接关系。用 30 秒在他们的事故频道里主动提供帮助。
prompts.ref: Hi all, sorry you're dealing with this. We saw a similar spike in connection errors last month, and it turned out to be a pool size setting after a config change. Not sure it's the same thing, but I can share the dashboard we used to find it. If an extra pair of eyes would help, I'm free for the next hour.
prompts.ref_zh: 大家好，辛苦了。我们上个月也遇到过类似的连接错误突增，最后发现是一次配置变更后连接池大小设置的问题。不确定是不是同一回事，但我可以把我们当时用来定位的 dashboard 分享出来。如果需要多一双眼睛帮忙看，接下来一个小时我都有空。

words.ex: Phrase it as a question so it doesn't sound like a demand.
Every on-time delivery is a deposit in your trust account.
Asking them to work the weekend is a big withdrawal.
Small improvements in test speed compound over a year.
The job failed precisely when the backup started.
Keep the incident channel professional, even under pressure.
Sharing data early isn't manipulation; it's good planning.
We opened an incident as soon as the error rate passed the threshold.
Her insight into the query planner saved us a week.
